import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
fixed = main.with_name('LogAnalysisSkill-a0-43a6aa6')
sys.path.insert(0, str(main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
from terminal_predicates import canonical_hash, check_frozen_hashes, load_json

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=main)

tracked = git('ls-files', '-z').decode().split('\0')
prior_evidence = [p for p in tracked if p and '/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/' in p]
production = [p for p in tracked if p and (p.startswith('release-v1.4.0/') or (p.startswith('tizen-') and '/scripts/' in p))]
protected = [
    'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/'+p
    for p in ('predicates.json','measurement_exemptions.json','expected_diff.json','scenario_manifest.json','result_schema.json')
]
protected += ['docs/clang-fix-campaign/design.md']
for path in prior_evidence + protected:
    assert (main/path).read_bytes() == git('show', 'HEAD:'+path), path
for path in production:
    assert (main/path).read_bytes() == git('show', 'HEAD:'+path), path
    assert (main/path).read_bytes() == (fixed/path).read_bytes(), path
data = main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data'
predicates = load_json(data/'predicates.json')
exemptions = load_json(data/'measurement_exemptions.json')
check_frozen_hashes(predicates, exemptions)
print('predicates_canonical='+canonical_hash(predicates))
print('exemptions_canonical='+canonical_hash(exemptions))
evidence = main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence'
def results(path):
    matches = re.findall(r'^(?:\.\./LogAnalysisSkill/)?(tests/.+?) (PASSED|FAILED|SKIPPED)(?:\s|$)', path.read_text(), re.M)
    result = dict(matches)
    assert len(result) == len(matches)
    return result
old = results(evidence/'part3/erratum10/full-regression-final.log')
new = results(evidence/'phase1/erratum11/whole-repo-final.log')
assert len(old) == 1301 and len(new) == 1305
assert old.keys() <= new.keys()
added = sorted(new.keys()-old.keys())
changed = [{'nodeid':key,'old':old[key],'new':new[key]} for key in old if old[key] != new[key]]
assert len(added) == 4 and len(changed) == 14
assert all(new[key] == 'PASSED' for key in added)
assert all(row['old'] == 'PASSED' and row['new'] == 'FAILED' for row in changed)
report = {'old_nodeids':len(old),'new_nodeids':len(new),'missing':[], 'added':added,'status_changes':changed}
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(f'prior_evidence_unchanged={len(prior_evidence)} protected_inputs_unchanged={len(protected)} production_release_unchanged={len(production)}')
print('authority_sha256='+hashlib.sha256((main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/p49-terminal-batch-design-v1.31-FROZEN.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('INTEGRITY=PASS; REGRESSION=FAIL (14 existing statuses changed, not suppressed)')
